Macroinvertebrates in an insecticide and temperature mesocosm experiment

Source: R/data.R
hermann_macroinvertebrates.Rd

Macroinvertebrate counts from the mesocosm experiment of Hermann et al. (2024) with an insecticide and three temperature regimes, sampled once before the first insecticide application and six times after it.

Usage

hermann_macroinvertebrates

Format

A data frame with 168 rows (24 mesocosms x 7 sampling days) and 34 columns:

mesocosm, imidacloprid, temperature

As in hermann_zooplankton.

day

Day relative to the first imidacloprid application (integer: -7, 7, 21, 35, 49, 63, 77).

total_abundance

Sum of the 29 taxon columns.

erpobdella

Erpobdella sp.

lumbriculidae

Lumbriculidae

hydracarina

Hydracarina

sphaeriidae

Sphaeriidae

Elmidae adult

elmidae_larvae

Elmidae larvae

echinogammarus

Echinogammarus

chironomini

Chironomini

culicidae

Culicidae

diptera_pupa

Diptera pupa

Orthocladiinae

Caenidae

Cloeon sp.

heptageniidae

Heptageniidae

Hydrobiidae

physella_acuta

Planorbidae

zygoptera

The taxon columns hold the number of individuals of each taxon of the source file, whose name for the taxon is given above and in the attribute "taxa"; the article describes four bottom traps per mesocosm. Counts are as reported in the source file. Zeros are taxa not found in the sample; there are no missing values.

Source

Hermann et al. (2024), Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.11520459 (full reference in hermann_zooplankton). Licence CC BY 4.0. Sheets "MacroinvertebratesDesign" and "Macroinvertebrates_Abundances"; script data-raw/hermann_2024.R of the source repository.

Experimental design

Twenty-four outdoor mesocosms (about 850 L of water over a sediment layer) at Alcalá de Henares (central Spain), from 19 April (day -7) to 19 July 2021, four per combination of a 2 x 3 factorial: imidacloprid (nominal 1 µg/L, applied on days 0, 14 and 28, or absent) and temperature (ambient; elevated, 4 °C above ambient; or three heatwaves of 7 days, separated by 7 days at ambient temperature, with targets of 24, 28 and 32 °C). The temperature treatments lasted from day 0 to day 42; days 42 to 84 were a recovery phase.

The community tables hermann_zooplankton, hermann_phytoplankton and hermann_macroinvertebrates code the mesocosms by treatment and replicate number ("C0A1"); hermann_water_quality, hermann_nutrients, hermann_leaf_litter and hermann_imidacloprid by mesocosm number ("M01"). The source gives no correspondence between the two codings, so the two kinds of table cannot be joined by mesocosm.

References

Hermann, M., Polazzo, F., Cherta, L., Crettaz-Minaglia, M., García-Astillero, A., Peeters, E. T. H. M., Rico, A., & Van den Brink, P. J. (2024). Combined stress of an insecticide and heatwaves or elevated temperature induce community and food web effects in a Mediterranean freshwater ecosystem. Water Research, 260, 121903. doi:10.1016/j.watres.2024.121903

See also

Other data of Hermann et al. (2024): hermann_imidacloprid, hermann_leaf_litter, hermann_nutrients, hermann_phytoplankton, hermann_water_quality, hermann_zooplankton

Examples

range(hermann_macroinvertebrates$total_abundance)
#> [1]  48 635
# Samples in which each taxon was found
taxa <- names(attr(hermann_macroinvertebrates, "taxa"))
sort(colSums(hermann_macroinvertebrates[taxa] > 0), decreasing = TRUE)
